jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
About Our Client:

The organization operates within the technology sector, focusing on designing and securing infrastructure for its clients. It addresses the challenge of maintaining high standards for internal technology environments in a remote-first setting, ensuring that its own operations reflect the quality delivered to clients. The company integrates AI governance and security practices to enhance both internal and client-facing technology solutions.

About the Opportunity:

The DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY is responsible for leading and managing the internal technology environment. This role involves setting the technology strategy, building and developing the IT team, and overseeing the adoption and governance of AI within the organization. The position plays a vital role in ensuring that the internal IT infrastructure operates at the same high standard as client-facing solutions, contributing to overall organizational effectiveness and security.

Responsibilities:

Develop and execute a multi-year internal technology roadmap covering identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, and service management
Align technology investments with business outcomes and define success metrics
Determine which IT functions are handled internally versus through partners
Establish IT governance, standards, architecture review, and change management processes
Design and build the internal IT team, including headcount planning and hiring
Mentor the team and define ownership, on-call, and escalation procedures
Develop an internal service catalog with defined service levels
Lead internal AI tool development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement
Collaborate with AI practice teams to inform client delivery
Manage AI financial engineering, including cost modeling and consumption forecasting
Oversee endpoint management and device lifecycle processes
Manage Microsoft 365 collaboration tools and enforce device requirements for a remote workforce
Own internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity
Manage cloud and hosting resources, including capacity and cost
Ensure backup, recovery, and business continuity with tested recovery objectives
Establish and mature IT service management processes
Publish operational metrics and reduce employee friction points
Manage onboarding and offboarding technology experiences with HR
Oversee IT budget, forecasting, and software license management
Rationalize SaaS applications and manage vendor relationships and contracts
Partner with security leadership to execute security programs and support compliance audits
Manage vulnerability assessment and remediation for internal systems

Requirements:

Minimum 10 years in information technology with leadership or technology ownership experience
Proven ability to build and scale IT in a distributed or remote-first fast-growth environment
Experience presenting technology strategies and metrics to executives
Expertise in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS at scale
Experience with internal AI adoption, governance, and change management
Strong security knowledge and ability to collaborate with CISOs and communicate risks to executives
Experience in solutions providers, MSPs, or consulting preferred
Familiarity with audit, SOC 2, or regulated compliance processes
Vendor management, contract negotiation, and budget experience
Effective communication skills with technical and executive audiences
Industry certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, CISSP/CISM, PMP are valued but not required

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Benefits & Perks:

Medical Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
Flexible time off plan
15 paid holidays
Sick leave (compliant with state requirements)
Short-term and long-term disability
Life insurance
Paid parental leave

Equal Opportunity Statement:
Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:

RemoteHunter is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.

jobs.title: Senior IT Manager, Change Management & Project Management Office
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Senior IT Manager for Change Management and Project Management Office is responsible for driving organizational transformation through effective change management strategies and ensuring successful delivery of IT projects. This role oversees the Project Management Office, establishes governance frameworks, and aligns initiatives with business objectives to maximize value and minimize risk. This role ensures successful delivery of complex technology programs, fosters adoption of new processes and systems, and aligns IT projects with enterprise objectives. This position will champion digital transformation, innovation, and a culture of agility across the organization. The position serves as a key liaison between IT leadership, business stakeholders, and project teams to foster a culture of agility, accountability, and continuous improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead the Project Management Office, establishing governance frameworks and portfolio management processes.
Oversee the project and work intake process to ensure the alignment of IT projects with business priorities, ensuring optimal resource allocation and value delivery.
Define and execute the global change management strategy for IT and business initiatives.
Develop and implement change management plans to support the adoption of new technologies and processes.
Partner with business units to assess change impacts and design communication, training, and engagement strategies.
Establish PMO standards, methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid), and best practices.
Oversee end-to-end project lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with risk, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Manage project portfolio performance, including prioritization, budgeting, and vendor oversight.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on change and project management matters.
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and resolve escalated issues impacting delivery.
Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes to executive stakeholders with clarity and transparency.
Build and mentor a high-performing team of project managers and change management professionals.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement within the PMO and with business partners.
Work with the business process owners to standardize the technology platform and support processes for regional and global IT systems
Develop proposals, statements of work, business requirements documents, resource planning and project plans
Drive process automation and effective management to replace manual operations and create efficiencies
Drive IT risk, security, and compliance awareness as part of the project and ongoing business processes.
Support the business stakeholders in management and definition of business requirements for systems including enhancements and new functions
Identify and manage risks and issues proactively, including resources, costs, and systems, and recommend appropriate solutions.
Review and assist in the development and delivery of system and process training to the user community through webinars, videos, knowledge base, and other employee engagement practices
Define and publish regular IT Project and change management metrics and KPIs
Monitor change readiness and adoption metrics, reporting progress to executive leadership.
Other duties as assigned

PERSON SPECIFICATION:
(minimum education requirements, key skills and experience)

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant technology, engineering, aviation/transportation, or computer science field or relevant experience

Experience:

15+ years’ of experience within Information Technology: supporting systems, people and processes
Experience leading, managing, and delivering projects, managing both external clients/stakeholders and internal leaders and project teams
Extensive experience with ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365), ITSM tools (ServiceNow), HRIS (Workday) and PPM tools (MS Project, Planner, Monday).
Experience with managing and leading Projects
Expertise in Project Management concepts (certification preferred)
Experience with the Solution Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process
Experience with IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework, especially around Change & Release Management
Experience with IT organizational and business change management concepts (certification preferred)

Skills:

Ability to translate business requirements into technology requirements
Strong strategic vision with a hands-on approach to operational excellence.
Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
Proven ability to manage budgets, drive cost savings, and achieve IT ROI
Microsoft Office Intermediate skills
Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Toolsets: MS Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, etc
Excellent Presentation Skills
Results-oriented and continuous improvement mindset
Strong verbal and written communication skills at all levels, including with leadership and management
Highly organized with the ability to organize own workload
Highly motivated with the skills and temperament to function effectively and efficiently in a Corporate environment
Exhibit a high level of integrity and confidentiality
Ability to keep a level head when working under pressure
Dedicated to promoting a positive image of the organization
Ability to work and manage remote teams
Proactive and enthusiastic, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves
Ability to travel to various operational locations as requested

jobs.title: Vice President, Cyber, Technology and Information Security (CTIS) Risk Oversight Lead
jobs.description:
Morgan Stanley is seeking a Vice President, Cyber, Technology and Information Security (CTIS) Risk Oversight Lead in the CTIS team within Non-Financial Risk.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading a team focused on independent oversight and monitoring of risks and controls around the Firm's cyber, technology and information security risks, with a focus on areas including IT resilience, architecture and design, asset management, vulnerability and patch management, cyber threat intelligence, network security, IAM, change management, and other related areas. The ideal candidate will bring operational knowledge and experience paired with a strong risk and control lens.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What You'll Do In The Role

Provide independent oversight and challenge of the Firm's cybersecurity and technology organizations risk management activities.
Manage the team in assessing the effectiveness of risk and control frameworks supporting new technology infrastructure, applications, cyber defenses, and information security programs.
Lead the team in review and challenge of risk assessments, control evaluations, issue remediation plans, and risk acceptance decisions.
Build and maintain strong positive relationships and partner with Technology, Non-Financial Risk, Legal, Audit, and business stakeholders to identify and address emerging risks.
Evaluate new technology initiatives and strategic transformation programs from a risk perspective.
Manage the team in monitoring key risk indicators (KRIs), metrics, and trends to identify areas requiring enhanced oversight or escalation.
Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and governance committee reporting related to technology and cyber risk.
Drive consistency in risk management practices, ensuring policy requirements, governance standards, and other risk guidance are appropriately addressed.
Manage the team in preparing executive-level risk reporting and deliver presentations for senior management and at risk governance forums.
Contribute to the development and enhancement of Enterprise Risk Management and NFR programs.
Provide thought leadership on emerging technology, cyber threats, and regulatory developments.

What You'll Bring To The Role

College degree (STEM or Information Security, preferable but not essential)
10+ years of technology and or security risk related work experience, preferably in the financial services industry
Experience in Technology (IT) Risk Management and/or Technology (IT) Audit including Information Security and or Cyber Security
Strong leadership, people management, stakeholder management and influencing skills
Strong interpersonal skills to work in a team-oriented environment
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written; ability to produce concise and effective presentations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences
Strong project management and organization skills
Ability to multitask and prioritize
Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
Flexible and self-motivator
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in MS Office and related applications (e.g. Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $120000 and $210000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

jobs.title: VP, Technology & AI
jobs.description:
The VP, Technology & AI (T&AI)
is a newly created leadership position at Woodruff. We’re looking for a transparent, innovative and results-driven leader with a diverse background to lead our technology vision and delivery capabilities within our T&AI core strength.

This role is responsible for advancing how technology, with an emphasis on AI, enhances both client outcomes and agency operations. By combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking perspective on emerging technologies, this role ensures the agency remains at the forefront of digital experience development, automation, integration, quality assurance and AI-driven innovation.

This leader plays a key role in evaluating and implementing AI initiatives that improve efficiency, expand service offerings and create competitive advantage. The ideal candidate will partner closely with other agency leadership and cross-functional teams to shape future capabilities, establish best practices and foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

The VP of technology & AI will be a member of Woodruff’s leadership team, working closely with them to drive forward-thinking strategies and impactful technology solutions in order to achieve our goals and build a strong business and culture of trust. This person will also be responsible for building, mentoring and developing high-performing technology teams, ensuring technology strengths continue to evolve and drive long-term agency success.

This person must be located in the Kansas City or Columbia, MO, area.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Technology & AI Leadership

Define and lead the agency's technology and AI vision and roadmap, ensuring investments align with client needs and future growth opportunities
Establish and champion the agency's AI strategy, identifying where and how AI can create value across internal operations, client work, workflows and service offerings
Lead a disciplined approach to AI adoption by focusing investments in high-impact opportunities with clear outcomes
Pilot and implement emerging technologies, AI platforms and other technical solutions that improve efficiency, enhance capabilities and create competitive advantage
Develop and oversee AI governance, policies and best practices to ensure responsible, effective and secure adoption across the organization
Define the agency's vision for search in the AI era by integrating SEO, AI optimization (AIO), structured data and generative search best practices into client strategies while mentoring teams on emerging technologies and evolving search behavior
Serve as the agency's technology and AI thought leader, staying ahead of emerging technologies, evolving AI legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practices while educating teams, guiding responsible AI adoption and driving the implementation of innovative tools and approaches that deliver measurable business value
Oversee our internal technology needs and external IT services, collaborating with our operations team.

Technical Strategy & Executional Leadership

Advise internal teams and clients on technology and AI opportunities, helping shape strategies that improve business outcomes, customer experiences and operational effectiveness
Alongside our technical architect, provide deep technical expertise and practical guidance to ensure the successful execution of complex digital and technology initiatives
Alongside our technical architect, consult on the development, implementation, QA and maintenance of websites, digital platforms, applications, marketing technology solutions and integrated technology ecosystems
Roll up your sleeves to support critical initiatives, using hands-on execution as a vehicle for coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Cross-Function Collaboration

Partner with agency leadership and cross-functional teams to assess and evolve technology and AI capabilities that support agency growth
Foster interconnected ways of working across core strengths, ensuring technology and AI considerations are integrated throughout project life cycles
Establish and improve documentation standards, workflows and operational processes that strengthen collaboration across disciplines and create greater visibility into how systems, tools, teams and technologies work together
Support business development, scoping and estimation efforts by providing technical expertise and strategic guidance during planning and proposal development.

Team Development

Build, mentor and develop high-performing technology teams while cultivating a culture of innovation and continuous learning
Continuously assess the performance, structure and maturity of the Technology & AI core strength, making recommendations that strengthen capabilities, improve delivery and support long-term agency success.

Supervisor Expectations:

Expectation setting, including working with your direct report on new staff orientation, training and work assignment
Departmental responsibilities, including working with your direct report on policy enforcements, OOO requests and adhering to hiring criteria
Regular communication, including one-on-ones, conflict resolution, philosophy guidance and ongoing coaching and mentoring
Employee enrichment, including working with your direct report on goal setting, timely performance reviews and ongoing feedback.

Knowledge and Skills:

Demonstrated success leading technology and AI strategy within an agency, consulting firm or complex marketing organization
Deep understanding of web technologies, marketing technology ecosystems systems integration and digital platforms
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies that drive measurable business outcomes
Strong understanding of SEO, AI optimization (AIO), generative search and the evolving search landscape
Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business solutions
Experience leading cross-functional teams and mentoring technical professionals
Working knowledge of AI governance, privacy, security and the evolving regulatory landscape
Working knowledge of current web technologies
Working knowledge of CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal and/or Hubspot
Working knowledge of email marketing or CRM platforms such as SalesForce and/or Campaign Monitor
An entrepreneurial, forward-thinking spirit
Happy to build relationships and trust, connect the dots, find a better way to solve existing problems
Ability to identify simpler ways to solve problems
Ability to embrace our core value of freedom — to be bold, to experiment, to challenge, to act and to celebrate — and a history of doing so throughout their career.

Leader Behaviors:

Open-minded and active listener
Continually grows people and business
Truthful and transparent
Decisive and accountable
Forward-thinking
Proactive and communicates in a positive manner

Education/Experience/Certification(s):

12+ years of relevant experience in a technology and AI field
Both agency and non-agency experience is applicable
Experience in leading a cross-functional team
Change management experience
Agile development experience

Woodruff’s Perks That Support Growth and Flexibility:

We offer a range of benefits designed to support your work-life balance and empower you to stay creative, curious and courageous:
Flexible work setup — choose hybrid work, or join us in our Kansas City or Columbia, MO, offices
"Freedom Fridays" — no meetings on Friday mornings/Friday afternoons to use as you see fit
Diverse, meaningful work — contribute to projects across a wide range of industries
Collaborative, growth-focused culture — work with a supportive team that helps you build new skills
And more — from wellness support to peer recognition, we value and invest in our people.

jobs.title: Director, Development
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange, a subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE), presents a unique opportunity for a full-time hands-on Director of Engineering to lead and drive the strategic technical vision for trading systems development in a high throughput, low latency trading environment. This senior leadership role carries end-to-end ownership of the architecture, design, and delivery of core systems powering NYSE Equity and Options markets on the cutting-edge Pillar platform. The Director of Engineering will lead multiple engineering teams, set the long-term technical direction, and serve as the key decision-maker on platform architecture — ensuring world-class reliability, performance, and innovation across the trading technology portfolio.

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design Ownership
Own and drive the end-to-end system architecture and technical roadmap for NYSE's high performance, high availability, high throughput trading platform.
Serve as the final technical authority on architectural and design decisions, ensuring alignment with long-term business strategy and scalability goals.
Define and enforce engineering standards, design patterns, and best practices across all teams and system components.
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies and approaches to maintain a competitive, next-generation platform.

Engineering Leadership & Team Development
Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams, including Principal Engineers, Senior Engineers, and individual contributors, fostering a culture of technical excellence and accountability.
Recruit, retain, and develop top-tier engineering talent; drive career development, succession planning, and performance management across the organization.
Champion a collaborative and innovative engineering culture that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Strategic Planning & Execution
Partner with senior business, product, and operations leadership to translate business objectives into technical strategy and execution plans.
Own program-level planning, prioritization, and delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives with organization-wide impact.
Establish and track key engineering metrics (system performance, reliability, delivery velocity) and drive continuous improvement against those benchmarks.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, and resource allocation decisions.

Operational Excellence
Ensure the highest levels of system reliability, availability, and regulatory compliance for mission-critical trading infrastructure.
Drive incident management, root-cause analysis, and systemic improvements to reduce operational risk.
Effectively represent engineering in cross-organizational forums, regulatory reviews, and executive-level discussions.

Knowledge And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related degree.
15+ years of progressive hands-on software engineering experience, including significant depth in C/C++ development on Linux.
5+ years in a senior engineering leadership role with demonstrated experience managing and scaling multiple teams.
Proven track record of owning and driving large-scale system architecture and design for high performance, low latency, mission-critical platforms.
Deep expertise in data structures, algorithmic complexity, systems programming, and performance-oriented software design.
Strong hands-on background with TCP/IP, Multicast network protocols, multithreading, and real-time systems.
Experience with scripting languages and automation in complex engineering environments.
Experience with AI assisted coding tools and agents for automating development workflows

Leadership And Strategic Skills

Demonstrated ability to set technical vision, influence across organizational boundaries, and drive alignment between engineering, business, and operations leadership.
Experience managing engineering budgets, roadmaps, and cross-functional programs at scale.
Strong executive communication skills — ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and represent engineering at the executive level.
Track record of building, mentoring, and retaining high-performing engineering organizations.
Experience operating within regulated financial services or exchange environments is strongly preferred.

New York Base Salary Range

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $215,000 - 285,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Director, Technology - Implementation
jobs.description:
The Machine is Code & Theory's AI orchestration platform — the engine that operationalizes AI across our work and, increasingly, across Stagwell, the global marketing and communications network Code & Theory is part of. The Machine integrates with the tools customers already use (Figma, Slack, Teams, Adobe, performance dashboards) and serves both Stagwell's internal agencies and enterprise brand customers including Qualcomm, TIME, and Stanley Black & Decker.

We're looking for a Director of Implementation to own how the Machine lands inside customer and agency environments. This is the role that turns a powerful platform into working systems for real teams: scoping engagements, leading deployment, integrating with existing tooling, and driving adoption through to measurable outcomes. You'll lead a team of implementation engineers and solution architects, and you'll be the connective tissue between the platform's capabilities and what each customer needs from it.

Our engineers are AI native and engage in and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development with AI.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own end-to-end implementation of the Machine across customer and agency environments, from technical scoping through deployment, integration, and adoption – you will write code and lots of it – daily
Stand up and lead a team of implementation engineers and solution architects, setting delivery standards and accountable for the quality and pace of every engagement
Translate customer requirements into deployment plans, working closely with the platform engineering team to surface gaps, prioritize integrations, and feed real-world needs back into the roadmap
Design integrations against the tools customers already run, making the Machine work alongside Figma, Slack, Teams, Adobe, performance dashboards, and the rest of a customer's stack
Drive adoption past go-live, defining what success looks like for each engagement and steering teams toward it with the right enablement, instrumentation, and follow-through
Partner across engineering, account, and customer stakeholders, coordinating reporting lines and expectations so delivery holds together as one effort

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

A track record of leading technical implementations or professional-services delivery for a software or platform product, ideally in environments with demanding enterprise customers
Strong technical fluency across cloud, integrations, and APIs — enough to architect a deployment, debug an integration, and earn the trust of the engineers you lead
Fantastic verbal communications and presentation skills, since this is a customer-facing role and you must have experience owning customer relationships through delivery, including the hard conversations about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs
People leadership experience, including in matrixed or cross-functional structures where influence matters as much as authority
A bias toward adoption and outcomes, with conviction about what separates a deployed tool from one a team actually uses
Comfort leveraging AI-enabled development tools and workflows to accelerate engineering, automation, debugging, and operational tasks
Experience orchestrating multi-step AI or agent-driven workflows, including selecting appropriate models, tools, and execution patterns for different use cases
Strong judgment reviewing and hardening AI-assisted output for security, scalability, maintainability, and architectural fit
Experience building or maintaining prompts, evaluation frameworks, documentation, or operational context systems that improve engineering velocity and reliability
Familiarity with automated evaluation and feedback loops for AI-enabled systems and workflows

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $150,000 – $225,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

jobs.title: Senior Technology Project Manager - Enterprise Technology PMO
jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

Maximus
is currently seeking a Senior Technology Project Manager
to lead and track the development and implementation of a complex, strategic initiative across multiple development or service teams. This role requires strong project management skills and the technical acumen to understand and coordinate system-level functions. The successful candidate will ensure alignment with strategic goals, manage dependencies, and support execution from planning through delivery.

This is a remote position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Serve as the point of contact and client interface for project technology related issues.
Manage project expectations, evaluate project needs, and communicate with stakeholders to ensure that program needs are met with respect to urgency and priority.
Develop trust, credibility, and strong client relationships; seeks opportunities to add value to internal and external client initiatives.
Review all project deliverables to ensure quality and accuracy meet project, stakeholder, and contractual standards.
Execute all project management functions including; work breakdown and cost estimation, scheduling, monitoring and tracking of technical progress against the defined timetables and budgets, and staff assignment and development.
Lead and direct the successful delivery of application development, systems integration, infrastructure, and product installation/customization services while ensuring that assigned projects adhere to the approved life cycle work patterns, standards, and procedures for solution delivery.
Define and implement development plans for assigned projects.
Typically responsible for providing guidance, coaching, and training to other employees within job area.
Ensure staff is knowledgeable on the applications and technologies in use on the project and that project team understands and follows processes and procedures.
Provide detailed direction during various stages of the lifecycle to include requirements analysis, testing, and potentially programming support.
Identify and assess new functional capabilities supporting engineering change proposals and additional follow on work.
Identify, track, manage, and communicate risks and issues with stakeholders and upper management.
Coordinate, prepare, and manage technical presentations and functional demonstrations to internal and external stakeholders.

Job-Specific Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Serve as the primary point of contact between program leadership and external (government) client representatives to ensure clear communication and alignment across the project lifecycle (initiate, plan, execute, monitor/control, close).
Strong communication skills, including executive briefings and clear written status reporting.
Coordinate daily with Chief Engineer and Lead Product Owner to manage the full project lifecycle with a focus on maintaining the requirements register, cross-team dependencies, risk assessments, and reference architectures.
Build and manage client relationships; align expectations with sponsors and stakeholders in accordance with the contract or program scope; and proactively surface risks, decisions, and tradeoffs to maintain alignment to contract scope, priorities, and outcomes.
Plan and lead program kickoffs and provide weekly updates and monthly/quarterly program management reviews
Ensure Chief Engineer and Lead Product Owner are synchronized to drive recurring delivery ceremonies (e.g., dev/test standups, sprint reviews, integrated planning sessions, stakeholder briefings) in order to meet requirements and technical program milestones.
Facilitate cross-functional coordination among business operations, engineering, security, and senior leadership to ensure requirements, priorities, and approvals are understood, documented, and executed.
Lead and develop program resources (direct reports and/or matrixed team members) through clear goal setting, prioritization, coaching, performance feedback, and escalation management; drive accountability by influence across engineering, product, operations, and vendors to deliver integrated program outcomes.
Provide routine status reporting and executive-level briefings; identify and escalate schedule, scope, cost, quality, and resource impacts; and support change control by ensuring change requests are documented at the appropriate levels and driving approvals with appropriate stakeholders.
Work with Chief Engineer to stay apprised of release and delivery schedules in order to ensure Transition Schedules and/or Contract Deliverables are met.
Manage action items and the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), including identifying and analyzing risks, developing realistic mitigation plans, communicating impacts and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders, and incorporating updates into the integrated project plan.
Partner with finance and business operations to manage budget execution, staffing plans, and resource forecasts, including tracking burn and variance against plan.
Partner with Contracts to manage and review project/contract deliverables and to proactively inform customer of any variances that may arise (due to schedule, scope creep, etc.).
Coordinate with Chief Engineer and Lead Product Owner to ensure quality and traceability to requirements and coordinate internal and client/government reviews to support timely acceptance.

new_jobs.title: Director, Technology - Implementation
new_jobs.description:
The Machine is Code & Theory's AI orchestration platform — the engine that operationalizes AI across our work and, increasingly, across Stagwell, the global marketing and communications network Code & Theory is part of. The Machine integrates with the tools customers already use (Figma, Slack, Teams, Adobe, performance dashboards) and serves both Stagwell's internal agencies and enterprise brand customers including Qualcomm, TIME, and Stanley Black & Decker.

We're looking for a Director of Implementation to own how the Machine lands inside customer and agency environments. This is the role that turns a powerful platform into working systems for real teams: scoping engagements, leading deployment, integrating with existing tooling, and driving adoption through to measurable outcomes. You'll lead a team of implementation engineers and solution architects, and you'll be the connective tissue between the platform's capabilities and what each customer needs from it.

Our engineers are AI native and engage in and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development with AI.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own end-to-end implementation of the Machine across customer and agency environments, from technical scoping through deployment, integration, and adoption – you will write code and lots of it – daily
Stand up and lead a team of implementation engineers and solution architects, setting delivery standards and accountable for the quality and pace of every engagement
Translate customer requirements into deployment plans, working closely with the platform engineering team to surface gaps, prioritize integrations, and feed real-world needs back into the roadmap
Design integrations against the tools customers already run, making the Machine work alongside Figma, Slack, Teams, Adobe, performance dashboards, and the rest of a customer's stack
Drive adoption past go-live, defining what success looks like for each engagement and steering teams toward it with the right enablement, instrumentation, and follow-through
Partner across engineering, account, and customer stakeholders, coordinating reporting lines and expectations so delivery holds together as one effort

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

A track record of leading technical implementations or professional-services delivery for a software or platform product, ideally in environments with demanding enterprise customers
Strong technical fluency across cloud, integrations, and APIs — enough to architect a deployment, debug an integration, and earn the trust of the engineers you lead
Fantastic verbal communications and presentation skills, since this is a customer-facing role and you must have experience owning customer relationships through delivery, including the hard conversations about scope, timelines, and tradeoffs
People leadership experience, including in matrixed or cross-functional structures where influence matters as much as authority
A bias toward adoption and outcomes, with conviction about what separates a deployed tool from one a team actually uses
Comfort leveraging AI-enabled development tools and workflows to accelerate engineering, automation, debugging, and operational tasks
Experience orchestrating multi-step AI or agent-driven workflows, including selecting appropriate models, tools, and execution patterns for different use cases
Strong judgment reviewing and hardening AI-assisted output for security, scalability, maintainability, and architectural fit
Experience building or maintaining prompts, evaluation frameworks, documentation, or operational context systems that improve engineering velocity and reliability
Familiarity with automated evaluation and feedback loops for AI-enabled systems and workflows

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $150,000 – $225,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.
